event_name: Date 28 September 2018 Time 12:09 2018 RUSSIAN GRAND PRIX 27 - 30 September 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 6), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 7th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), 6th Turbo Charger (TC), 6th Motor Generator Unit Heat (MGU-H), 6th Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K) and 4th Control Electronics have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article 23.3 b).
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
